BiblicalUsage: Adultery in the prophets is never only about the marriage bed. Jeremiah sees Jerusalem's adulteries on the hills in the fields, and Ezekiel speaks of one grown old in adulteries — the word covers the unfaithfulness of a people who have given themselves to other gods.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe that is why the prophets use this word for idolatry: unfaithfulness to God is adultery, and Jerusalem is asked when she will be made clean.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
